raw_segments.text: While Dagu and Queequeg were stopping the strained planks, and as the whales swimming
out from them, turned, and showed one entire flank as he shot by them again.
At that moment a quick cry went up.
Lashed round and round to the fish's back, pinioned in the turns upon turns in which,
during the past night, the whale had reeled the involutions of the lines around him.
The half-torn body of the Parsi was seen, his sable raiment frayed to shreds, his distended
eyes turned full upon old Ahab.
